_finding: health-check tells the owner about each B20 change once (docs/b20-transfers-tz.md §5, outside reviews of #268): each listed change not told, in block order, then the difference with its own kept baseline; never backwards; told only when Telegram took it; written after each alert sent.

mutations.name: a change told is not kept as told
mutations.find: applyChange(prev, c.kind === 'answer' ? { ...c, key: answerKey(c) } : c); prev.block = c.block
mutations.expect: FAIL a listed answer change is sent and kept under its answers key

mutations.name: a journal fallback counts as told
mutations.find: try { return (await alertImpl({ key: `b20:base:${token}`, text }, { env, everyMs: 0 })) === 'sent' } catch (_) { return false }
mutations.replace: try { return (await alertImpl({ key: `b20:base:${token}`, text }, { env, everyMs: 0 })) !== 'failed' } catch (_) { return false }

mutations.name: the kept baseline is written only at the end
mutations.expect: FAIL the first change is on disk before the second alert is sent

mutations.name: the site's list of changes is not read
mutations.expect: FAIL a pause and an unpause between two runs: two alerts

mutations.name: a listed change is sent again
mutations.expect: FAIL two changes in one block, the second alert failed

mutations.name: a baseline is diffed backwards
mutations.expect: FAIL a baseline at a block not above the last told

mutations.name: a listed change below the last told is sent
mutations.expect: FAIL a listed change at a block not above the last told

mutations.name: a baseline difference told is not kept as told
mutations.expect: FAIL a change the site saw while health-check was not running is still sent
